11. /// <para>
12. /// This attribute is applied to methods or properties that should be exposed as resources in the Model Context Protocol. When a class
13. /// containing methods marked with this attribute is registered with McpServerBuilderExtensions,
14. /// these methods or properties become available as resources that can be called by MCP clients.
15. /// </para>

17. /// When methods are provided directly to <see cref="M:McpServerResource.Create"/>, the attribute is not required.
18. /// </para>
19. /// <para>
20. /// Read resource requests do not contain separate arguments, only a URI. However, for templated resources, portions of that URI may be considered
21. /// as arguments and may be bound to parameters. Further, resource methods may accept parameters that will be bound to arguments based on their type.
22. /// <list type="bullet">
23. ///   <item>
24. ///     <description>
25. ///       <see cref="CancellationToken"/> parameters are automatically bound to a <see cref="CancellationToken"/> provided by the
26. ///       <see cref="McpServer"/> and that respects any <see cref="CancelledNotificationParams"/>s sent by the client for this operation's
27. ///       <see cref="RequestId"/>.
28. ///     </description>
29. ///   </item>
30. ///   <item>
31. ///     <description>
32. ///       <see cref="IServiceProvider"/> parameters are bound from the <see cref="RequestContext{ReadResourceRequestParams}"/> for this request.
33. ///     </description>
34. ///   </item>
35. ///   <item>
36. ///     <description>
37. ///       <see cref="McpServer"/> parameters are bound directly to the <see cref="McpServer"/> instance associated
38. ///       with this request's <see cref="RequestContext{ReadResourceRequestParams}"/>. Such parameters may be used to understand
39. ///       what server is being used to process the request, and to interact with the client issuing the request to that server.
40. ///     </description>
41. ///   </item>

43. ///     <description>
44. ///       <see cref="IProgress{ProgressNotificationValue}"/> parameters accepting <see cref="ProgressNotificationValue"/> values
45. ///       are bound to an <see cref="IProgress{ProgressNotificationValue}"/> instance manufactured to forward progress notifications
46. ///       from the resource to the client. If the client included a <see cref="ProgressToken"/> in their request, progress reports issued
47. ///       to this instance will propagate to the client as <see cref="NotificationMethods.ProgressNotification"/> notifications with
48. ///       that token. If the client did not include a <see cref="ProgressToken"/>, the instance will ignore any progress reports issued to it.
49. ///     </description>

54. ///       <see cref="McpServerResourceCreateOptions.Services"/>. Any parameter that can be satisfied by that <see cref="IServiceProvider"/>
55. ///       according to <see cref="IServiceProviderIsService"/> will be resolved from the <see cref="IServiceProvider"/> provided to the
56. ///       resource invocation rather than from the argument collection.
57. ///     </description>
58. ///   </item>
59. ///   <item>
60. ///     <description>
61. ///       Any parameter attributed with <see cref="FromKeyedServicesAttribute"/> will similarly be resolved from the
62. ///       <see cref="IServiceProvider"/> provided to the resource invocation rather than from the argument collection.
63. ///     </description>
64. ///   </item>
65. ///   <item>
66. ///     <description>
67. ///       All other parameters are bound from the data in the URI.
68. ///     </description>
69. ///   </item>
70. /// </list>
71. /// </para>

74. /// </para>

77. ///     <term><see cref="ResourceContents"/></term>

95. ///   </item>

98. ///     <description>Converted to a list containing a <see cref="TextResourceContents"/> for each <see cref="TextContentBlock"/> and a <see cref="BlobResourceContents"/> for each <see cref="DataContent"/>.</description>
99. ///   </item>
100. ///   <item>
101. ///     <term><see cref="IEnumerable{String}"/> of <see cref="string"/></term>
102. ///     <description>Converted to a list containing a <see cref="TextResourceContents"/>, one for each <see cref="string"/>.</description>
103. ///   </item>
104. /// </list>
105. /// <para>
106. /// Other returned types will result in an <see cref="InvalidOperationException"/> being thrown.
107. /// </para>

109. /// Parameters of type <see cref="string"/> that are decorated with <c>AllowedValuesAttribute</c>

111. /// without requiring a custom <see cref="McpServerHandlers.CompleteHandler"/> to be configured.
112. /// </para>

116. {

119.     /// </summary>

121.     {
122.     }

125.     /// <remarks>
126.     /// If <see langword="null"/>, a URI will be derived from <see cref="Name"/> and the method's parameter names.
127.     /// This template can, but doesn't have to, include parameters; if it does, this <see cref="McpServerResource"/>
128.     /// is considered a "resource template", and if it doesn't, it is considered a "direct resource".
129.     /// The former will be listed with <see cref="RequestMethods.ResourcesTemplatesList"/> requests and the latter
130.     /// with <see cref="RequestMethods.ResourcesList"/> requests.
131.     /// </remarks>

133.

135.     /// <remarks>If <see langword="null"/>, the method name is used.</remarks>
136.     public string? Name { get; set; }
137. 
138.     /// <summary>Gets or sets the title of the resource.</summary>
139.     public string? Title { get; set; }
140. 
141.     /// <summary>Gets or sets the MIME (media) type of the resource.</summary>
142.     public string? MimeType { get; set; }
143. 
144.     /// <summary>
145.     /// Gets or sets the source URI for the resource's icon.
146.     /// </summary>
147.     /// <remarks>
148.     /// <para>
149.     /// This can be an HTTP/HTTPS URL pointing to an image file or a data URI with base64-encoded image data.
150.     /// When specified, a single icon will be added to the resource.
151.     /// </para>
152.     /// <para>
153.     /// For more advanced icon configuration (multiple icons, MIME type specification, size characteristics),
154.     /// use <see cref="McpServerResourceCreateOptions.Icons"/> when creating the resource programmatically.
155.     /// </para>
156.     /// </remarks>
157.     public string? IconSource { get; set; }
